name: nop-ai-shell-bash-cst-frontend
description: Replace the hand-written BashLexer/BashSyntaxParser front-end in nop-ai-shell with a tree-sitter CST translator (nop-treesitter bash blob, corpus 100/100). Deliver a thin external interface (single entry point) whose coordination environment (command registry, checkers, fs, env, cwd, io, executor thread pool, background job sink, recursion/iteration limits) is passed via a session-level context object. Extend the CommandExpression hierarchy with control flow (if/elif/else, while/until, for-in, break/continue/return via command_name recognition) with loop termination safety (per-iteration cancel check, max iterations/timeout), condition semantics (exit-code conditions, test/[[ ]] builtins), $( ) command substitution with subshell snapshot isolation and recursion depth limit, structured word segments (literal/quoted/expansion/subst) enabling $VAR/$? expansion with single-quote suppression. Cover only the most common syntax; out-of-subset constructs are structurally rejected (node kind + source text + byte offset). Golden-equivalence protocol with deviation whitelist gates the cutover (old parser tests re-based: ParseException cases become structured rejections, empty input becomes success no-op, VAR=| echo becomes legal pipeline, &&/|| precedence follows bash). Terminal state: single bash syntax authority - hand-written lexer/parser deleted. Roadmap: ai-dev/backlog/nop-ai-shell-bash-cst-frontend-roadmap.md. Constraints: only the parsing front-end changes (io.nop.treesitter.shell analysis layer untouched); when a plan touches ShellCommandExecutor assembly, the check command must include nop-ai/nop-ai-agent (-am builds upstream only).
